name: Weasel Willy
summary: Weasel Willy is a game included in the Don't Buy This compilation for the ZX Spectrum. The player controls a character described as a weasel, though it appears on screen as a humanoid figure. In each level, the character has to avoid trees and its own footprints. The trees are placed at random positions when a level begins. As a result, a level can start with the character blocked in by trees, or with a tree on the same spot as the character, which ends the level at once.
